motion.name: button-background
motion.purpose: Button hover feedback; disabled under reduced motion.

motion.name: conflict-resolution
motion.purpose: Retained conflict feedback; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary{font:600 14px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius,8px);min-height:38px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out;background:var(--accent,#a99aff);color:var(--accent-ink,#181130);}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:#c1b5ff}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a99aff);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{font:600 14px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius,8px);min-height:38px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out;background:var(--raised,#1b2839);color:var(--ink,#e9f0fa);border-color:var(--rule,#2c3d52);}.ds-button-secondary:hover{background:#26374b}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a99aff);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-secondary{transition:none}}

components.name: Quiet Button
components.css: .ds-button-quiet{font:600 14px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius,8px);min-height:38px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 120ms ease-out;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#a7b9cf);}.ds-button-quiet:hover{background:#26374b}.ds-button-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a99aff);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button-quiet:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-quiet{transition:none}}

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Visible label and dark input surface.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-name">Device name</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-name" placeholder="Office computer">
components.css: .ds-label{display:block;color:var(--muted,#a7b9cf);font:13px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;margin-bottom:7px}.ds-input{width:100%;font:14px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;background:#101925;color:var(--ink,#e9f0fa);border:1px solid #3a4c63;border-radius:7px;padding:9px 12px;caret-color:var(--accent,#a99aff)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:#a1b2c8}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a99aff);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Current page is violet; other links remain muted.
components.html: MachinesDevices
components.css: .ds-nav{display:grid;gap:6px;font:14px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;background:var(--rail,#101824);padding:16px}.ds-nav a{display:flex;text-decoration:none;padding:10px 13px;border-radius:7px;font-weight:550;color:var(--muted,#a7b9cf)}.ds-nav a:hover{background:var(--raised,#1b2839)}.ds-nav a[aria-current=page]{background:#2b2545;color:#d6ccff}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#a99aff);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Success Badge
components.css: .ds-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font:550 12px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;border:1px solid #2a5044;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;background:#17382f;color:var(--success,#87d9ba);white-space:nowrap}

components.name: Panel
components.html:
Paired devices

Review trusted devices and their permissions.
components.css: .ds-panel{font:14px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#e9f0fa);background:var(--surface,#151f2d);border:1px solid var(--rule,#2c3d52);border-radius:10px;padding:24px}.ds-panel h2{font-size:20px;font-weight:620;letter-spacing:-.015em;margin:0 0 12px}.ds-panel p{color:var(--muted,#a7b9cf);margin:8px 0 16px;max-width:72ch}

components.name: Version Container
components.description: Matching container for either side of a conflict.
components.css: .ds-version{font:14px/1.55 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;color:var(--ink,#e9f0fa);padding:18px;background:#111b29;border:1px solid var(--rule,#2c3d52);border-radius:8px}.ds-version h3{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 8px}.ds-version pre{font:12px/1.55 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin:12px 0}

narrative.overview:
A modern dark application workspace for operating machines and trusted peers. Blue-black framing, slate work surfaces and crisp platform typography keep attention on named targets, trust and explicit choices. All interface copy is English.

The user-pinned replacement direction supersedes the rejected initial sketches. System typography follows native application conventions; this is an operational interface rather than a promotional surface.
keyCharacteristics: Blue-black shell and slate work surfaces.
Violet actions and selection; mint success and amber attention.
Compact, readable platform typography with clear keyboard focus.
Equal-weight conflict comparison with an explicit retained result.

rules.name: The Semantic Accent Rule
rules.body: Violet identifies actions and selection; mint, amber and rose identify success, attention and errors alongside readable labels.

rules.name: The Platform Type Rule
rules.body: Use the system sans-serif stack for the application hierarchy and monospace for technical values; keep interface copy English.

rules.name: The Equal Peers Rule
rules.body: Local and received versions receive matching containers before a choice is made.

dos: Do keep all interface copy English.
Do identify the target and execution device alongside operations.
Do retain equal visual weight for local and received conflict versions.
Do show text labels with semantic status colors.
Do preserve keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't revive the rejected initial admin-panel sketches.
Don't replace platform typography with promotional display assets.
Don't use color alone to convey trust, errors or selected versions.
Don't turn the application into a decorative metrics dashboard.
